title: Zarpazo sangriento
description: Zarpazo sangriento (Papagato, src/effects.ts `claw`): Haru pounces on a dog and her claws tear three white-coral lines across its body (Sangrado's scratches of light, no blood), from top right to bottom left, one a breath after another (`clawLines`); the blow under them stays small and throws coral sparks, and the dog flashes a soft coral. Gerard wears Papagato in the fight tester, on the Passatge Maresme. Run it with --gpu.

steps.caption: Haru pounces and her claws tear three white-coral lines across the dog, one a breath after another, with coral sparks; Sangrado × 2
